edges_two_way.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(m.edges); e++) { var a = m.edges[e].a; var b = m.edges[e].b; var la = m.nodes[a].links; var lb = m.nodes[b].links; var fa = false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(la); i++) if (la[i] == b) fa = true; var fb = false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(lb); i++) if (lb[i] == a) fb = true; if (!fa || !fb) return false; } } return true;

can_double_back.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; var l0 = m.nodes[0].links; if (array_length(l0) == 0) return false; for (var k = 0; k < array_length(l0); k++) { var t = l0[k]; var back = false; var lt = m.nodes[t].links; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(lt); i++) if (lt[i] == 0) back = true; if (!back) return false; } } return true;

all_reachable.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; var n = array_length(m.nodes); var seen = array_create(n, false); seen[0] = true; var changed = true; while (changed) { changed = false; for (var a = 0; a < n; a++) { if (!seen[a]) continue; var l = m.nodes[a].links; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(l); i++) { if (!seen[l[i]]) { seen[l[i]] = true; changed = true; } } } } for (var a = 0; a < n; a++) if (!seen[a]) return false; } return true;

denser_than_before.gml: var total = 0; var links = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; total += array_length(m.nodes); links += array_length(m.edges); } return (total / 30 >= 13 && links / 30 >= 18);

has_lateral_roads.gml: var found = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(m.edges); e++) { if (m.nodes[m.edges[e].a].col == m.nodes[m.edges[e].b].col) { found += 1; break; } } } return (found >= 20);

exit_exists.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 30; g++) { map_generate(); var m = global.run.map; var found = false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(m.nodes); i++) if (m.nodes[i].kind == "exit") found = true; if (!found) return false; } return true;

deadline_walls_off.gml: var r = global.run; map_generate(); r.deadline = 2.5; var blocked = 0; var l = map_reachable(); for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) { if (map_node_lost(i) && map_is_reachable(i)) { if (map_can_travel(i)) return false; blocked += 1; } } r.deadline = -1.6; return true;

find_fight.gml: var r = global.run; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) { if (r.map.nodes[i].kind == "fight") { global.test_node = i; r.node = i; return true; } } global.test_node = -1; return false;

fresh_node_fires.gml: var r = global.run; r.map.nodes[global.test_node].resolved = false; global.pending_room = -1; with (obj_map) { map_resolve_arrival(); } var fired = (global.pending_room != -1); global.pending_room = -1; return fired;

revisit_is_quiet.gml: var r = global.run; r.map.nodes[global.test_node].resolved = true; global.pending_room = -1; with (obj_map) { map_resolve_arrival(); } var fired = (global.pending_room != -1); global.pending_room = -1; return !fired;
